name: DarojaAI PR-Closeout Gate
description: Implements RFC DarojaAI/.github#33 pre-send gate: rejects outbound message(send) green-claim phrases when gh pr checks has not been observed for the referenced PR.
author: Milan Patel (no_decaf_milan)

greenClaimPhrases.description: Phrases that trigger the gate when no fresh gh pr checks observation exists.

prReferencePattern.description: Regex source used to extract PR numbers from outbound message content.
